audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer said 'Syndra' on all seven. The page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Syndra x7 and the win rate is 48.57% over 3352 games — the content layer is right and the full layer was stale. Syndra out-ranges Galio at every stage (Dark Sphere 800 on a flat 7s vs Winds of War 825 on 11s; Force of Will 925 vs a 275-range taunt).
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to Syndra with ratings and whys rewritten to match. content win[N] already reads Syndra on disk, so no content edit is required to keep the two layers in agreement.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed 'the moment she has 9 spheres queued' and spikes[3] called the ult 'flat percent-max-health true'. Neither number is in Riot's text.
audit.why: Kit gives Unleashed Power range 675, cooldown 120/100/80, execute flag only. Transcendent's true damage is on Force of Will (W), not the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Spikes now cite 675 range and the 120s rank-1 cooldown, and describe the ult as a low-health execute upgraded by Transcendent.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page sells MR as the answer ('your MR makes AP trades a subscription you sell') without noting that Transcendent makes Force of Will deal true damage, which resistances do not reduce.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated for this exact pair; enemyKit confirms trueDamage on both P and W.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early and phases[3].why now state that stacking MR does not refund Force of Will.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Now states Scatter the Weak flat 15s at every rank, Dark Sphere flat 7s, Unleashed Power 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fourteen fields called Syndra he/his/him, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
